blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Tuesday touted the historic signing of the Digital Economy Framework Agreement (Defa) during the Philippines’ chairmanship of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit. The agreement is the first-ever region-wide digital economy framework of its kind in the world. It aims to accelerate regional digital integration and double the value of the Asean digital economy from $1 trillion to $2 trillion by 2030.
